title.raw: 卷八十三 晉書9: 少帝本紀三 Volume 83 Book of Later Jin 9: Emperor Shao 3

sentences.zh: 開運元年秋七月辛未朔，帝御崇元殿，大赦天下，改天福九年為開運元年。

translations.literal: On the first day (xinwei) of the seventh month of autumn in the first year of Kaiyun, the Emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall, proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm, and changed the ninth year of Tianfu to the first year of Kaiyun.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the seventh month of autumn in Kaiyun 1, the emperor appeared at Chongyuan Hall, granted a general amnesty, and renamed the ninth Tianfu year as Kaiyun 1.

sentences.zh: 河北諸州，曾經契丹蹂踐處，與免今年秋稅。

translations.literal: The various prefectures of Hebei in places that had been trampled by the Khitan were granted exemption from this year's autumn tax.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures in Hebei that the Khitan had ravaged were exempted from the autumn levy for that year.

sentences.zh: 諸軍將士等第各賜優給。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers of the various armies were each given generous rewards according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and officers in every army received graded bonuses according to merit.

sentences.zh: 諸州率借錢帛，赦書到日，畫時罷征，出一千貫已上者與免科徭，一萬貫已上者與授本州上佐雲。

translations.literal: As for the forced loans of money and silk by the prefectures: when the amnesty edict arrived, collection was immediately halted; those who had advanced one thousand strings or more were exempted from corvée and taxes; those who had advanced ten thousand strings or more were granted an upper aide post in their prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Forced prefectural loans in cash and silk were to cease the moment the amnesty arrived; lenders of a thousand strings or more were freed from tax and corvée, and those of ten thousand or more were appointed senior aides in their home prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是日宣赦未畢，會大雷雨，匆遽而罷。

translations.literal: That day, before the amnesty proclamation was finished, a great thunderstorm came, and it was hurriedly stopped.
translations.idiomatic: That day the amnesty reading had not finished when a violent thunderstorm broke out, and the ceremony was cut short in haste.

sentences.zh: 時都下震死者數百人，明德門內震落石龍之首，識者以為石乃國姓，蓋不祥之甚也。

translations.literal: At the time several hundred people in the capital were killed by lightning; within the Mingde Gate the head of a stone dragon fell from a lightning strike. Those who understood omens said that stone represented the imperial surname—an extremely inauspicious sign.
translations.idiomatic: Lightning killed several hundred people in the capital, and at the Mingde Gate a stone dragon's head was struck loose. Omens readers noted that stone was the dynastic surname—a dire portent indeed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以定州節度使馬全節為鄴都留守，加兼侍中；

translations.literal: On guiyou, Ma Quanjie, military commissioner of Dingzhou, was made military governor of Yedu, with the additional title of Concurrent Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Ma Quanjie of Dingzhou became Yedu military governor and was also made Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 以昭義節度使安審暉為邢州節度使，加檢校太師。

translations.literal: An Shenhui, military commissioner of Zhaoyi, was made military commissioner of Xingzhou, with the added title of Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: An Shenhui of Zhaoyi was transferred to Xingzhou as commissioner and given acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，前陜州節度使王周加檢校太尉，改定州節度使；

translations.literal: On yihai, Wang Zhou, former military commissioner of Shaanzhou, was given the added title of Acting Grand Marshal and transferred to military commissioner of Dingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On yihai former Shaanzhou commissioner Wang Zhou received acting Grand Marshal and was reassigned to Dingzhou;

sentences.zh: 鄴都留守張從恩改鄆州節度使。

translations.literal: Zhang Cong'en, military governor of Yedu, was transferred to military commissioner of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yedu governor Zhang Cong'en became Yanzhou military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 禮官奏：「天子三年喪畢，祫享於太廟，高祖聖文章武明德孝皇帝今年八月喪終畢，合以十月行大祫之禮，冬季祠祭，改薦為祫。

translations.literal: The ritual officials memorialized: "When the Son of Heaven's three-year mourning is complete, he performs the he sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple. The three-year mourning for Emperor Gaozu, the Sagely, Cultured, Martial, and Brightly Virtuous Filial Emperor, will be completed this eighth month; it is fitting to conduct the great he rite in the tenth month. For the winter seasonal sacrifices, change the jian offering to he."
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials reported that after the three-year mourning the emperor should offer the he rite in the ancestral temple; Gaozu's mourning would end in the eighth month, so the great he ceremony should be held in the tenth month, and the winter seasonal service should be changed from jian to he.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court accepted this.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，虞部員外郎、知制誥陶穀改倉部郎中、知制誥，大理卿吳德謙改秘書監致仕。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Tao Gu, Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and Drafting Edict Drafter, was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Edict Drafter; Wu Deqian, Director of the Court of Judicial Review, was transferred to Director of the Secretariat and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Tao Gu moved from the Ministry of Works to the Ministry of Revenue while keeping his drafting duties; Wu Deqian left the Court of Judicial Review to retire as Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以左龍武統軍李從敏為潞州節度使，天策府都護軍、桂州節度使、知郎州軍事馬希杲加檢校太師。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Li Congmin, Commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, was made military commissioner of Luzhou; Ma Xigao, Protector-General of the Heavenly Strategies Office, military commissioner of Guizhou, and Administrator of Langzhou military affairs, was given the added title of Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Congmin of the Left Dragon Martial Army became Luzhou commissioner, and Ma Xigao of Guizhou and Langzhou received acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，降金州為防禦州，降萊州為刺史州。

translations.literal: On renwu, Jinzhou was reduced to a defense prefecture, and Laizhou was reduced to a prefecture governed by a prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Jinzhou was downgraded to a defense command and Laizhou to a standard prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎田敏改兵部侍郎；

translations.literal: Tian Min, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue, was transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of War;
translations.idiomatic: Tian Min moved from Revenue to War as vice minister;

sentences.zh: 刑部侍郎李祥改尚書右丞；

translations.literal: Li Xiang, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Justice, was transferred to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiang of Justice became Right Vice Director of State Affairs;

sentences.zh: 以潁州團練使馮玉為戶部侍郎，充端明殿學士；

translations.literal: Feng Yu, regimental training commissioner of Yingzhou, was made Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue and appointed Academician of the Duanming Hall;
translations.idiomatic: Yingzhou training commissioner Feng Yu became Revenue vice minister and a Duanming Hall academician;

sentences.zh: 中書舍人趙上交改刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: Zhao Shangjiao, Secretariat Drafter, was transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat drafter Zhao Shangjiao became Justice vice minister.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以樞密使、中書令桑維翰充宏文館大學士，太子太傅、譙國公劉句為守司空兼門下侍郎平章事、監修國史、判三司，宰臣李崧、和凝進封爵邑。

translations.literal: On jichou, Sang Weihan, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Palace Attendant-in-Chief, was appointed Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall; Liu Xu, Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and Duke of Qiao, was made Acting Minister of Works with Concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councilor, Supervisor of the Compilation of National History, and Controller of the Three Commissions; the chief ministers Li Song and He Ning were advanced in noble rank and fief.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Sang Weihan of the Bureau of Military Affairs became Hongwen Hall grand academician; Liu Xu of Qiao received acting Minister of Works with chancellor, historiography, and fiscal duties; chief ministers Li Song and He Ning gained higher titles and fiefs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，宣徽北院使劉繼勛改宣徽南院使，三司使董遇改宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Liu Jixun, Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat, was transferred to Commissioner of the Southern Court; Dong Yu, Commissioner of the Three Commissions, was transferred to Commissioner of the Northern Court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Jixun moved from the northern to the southern Palace Secretariat court, and Dong Yu of the Three Commissions took the northern post.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以前陜州節度使石赟為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Shi Yun, former military commissioner of Shaanzhou, was made military commissioner of Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao former Shaanzhou commissioner Shi Yun was appointed to Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 同州節度使李承福卒，贈太傅。

translations.literal: Li Chengfu, military commissioner of Tongzhou, died and was posthumously given the title Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhou commissioner Li Chengfu died and was posthumously honored as Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，命十五將以禦契丹，

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinchou, fifteen generals were appointed to resist the Khitan,
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the eighth month fifteen generals were ordered to meet the Khitan,

sentences.zh: （《東都事略·範質傳》：晉出帝命十五將出征。

translations.literal: (Biography of Fan Zhi in the Brief Account of the Eastern Capital: the Deposed Emperor of Jin ordered fifteen generals to take the field.)
translations.idiomatic: (Brief Account of the Eastern Capital, Biography of Fan Zhi: the Jin Deposed Emperor sent fifteen generals on campaign.)

sentences.zh: 是夕，質宿直，出帝命諸學士分草制，質曰：「宮城已閉，慮泄機事。

translations.literal: That night Fan Zhi was on night duty at court; the Deposed Emperor ordered the various academicians to draft the edicts separately. Fan Zhi said: "The palace gates are already closed—I fear military secrets may leak."
translations.idiomatic: That night Fan Zhi was on palace duty. When the emperor told the academicians to draft the orders separately, Fan Zhi said, "The palace is shut; we must not risk leaking the plan."

sentences.zh: 」遂獨為之。）〉

translations.literal: " He therefore drafted them alone.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " So he drafted them all himself.)〉

sentences.zh: 北京留守劉知遠充北面行營都統，鎮州節度使杜威充北面行營都招討使，鄆州節度使張從恩充馬步軍都監，西京留守景延廣充馬步軍都排陣使，徐州節度使趙在禮充馬步軍都虞候，晉州節度使安叔千充馬步軍左廂排陣使，前兗州節度使安審信充馬軍右廂排陣使，河中節度使安審琦充馬步軍都指揮使，河陽節度使符彥卿充馬軍左廂都指揮使，滑州節度使皇甫遇充馬步軍右廂都指揮使，右神武統軍張彥澤充馬軍排陣使，滄州節度使王廷胤充馬軍左廂都指揮使，陜州節度使宋彥筠充步軍右廂都指揮使，前金州節度使田武充步軍左廂排陣使，左神武統軍潘環充步軍右廂排陣使。

translations.literal: Liu Zhiyuan, military governor of the Northern Capital, was made overall commander of the northern campaign headquarters; Du Wei, military commissioner of Zhenzhou, was made chief commander of pacification of the northern campaign headquarters; Zhang Cong'en, military commissioner of Yanzhou, was made overall supervisor of horse and foot; Jing Yanguang, military governor of the Western Capital, was made chief array marshal of horse and foot; Zhao Zaili, military commissioner of Xuzhou, was made chief inspector of horse and foot; An Shuqian, military commissioner of Jinzhou, was made array marshal of the left wing of horse and foot; An Shenxin, former military commissioner of Yanzhou, was made array marshal of the right wing of the cavalry; An Shenqi, military commissioner of Hezhong, was made overall commander of horse and foot; Fu Yanqing, military commissioner of Heyang, was made overall commander of the left wing of the cavalry; Huangfu Yu, military commissioner of Huazhou, was made overall commander of the right wing of horse and foot; Zhang Yanzhe, commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, was made cavalry array marshal; Wang Tingyin, military commissioner of Cangzhou, was made overall commander of the left wing of the cavalry; Song Yanjun, military commissioner of Shaanzhou, was made overall commander of the right wing of the infantry; Tian Wu, former military commissioner of Jinzhou, was made array marshal of the left wing of the infantry; Pan Huan, commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, was made array marshal of the right wing of the infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhiyuan of the Northern Capital headed the northern headquarters; Du Wei of Zhenzhou was chief pacification commander; Zhang Cong'en of Yanzhou supervised horse and foot; Jing Yanguang of the Western Capital arranged the battle line; Zhao Zaili of Xuzhou was chief inspector; An Shuqian of Jinzhou led the left wing; former Yanzhou commissioner An Shenxin led the cavalry right; An Shenqi of Hezhong commanded horse and foot; Fu Yanqing of Heyang commanded the cavalry left; Huangfu Yu of Huazhou commanded the right wing; Zhang Yanzhe of the Right Divine Martial Army led the cavalry line; Wang Tingyin of Cangzhou commanded the cavalry left wing; Song Yanjun of Shaanzhou commanded the infantry right; former Jinzhou commissioner Tian Wu arrayed the infantry left; Pan Huan of the Left Divine Martial Army arrayed the infantry right.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，閩王王延羲為其下連重遇、朱文進所害，眾推文進知留後事，稱天福年號，間道以聞。

translations.literal: On renyin, the King of Min Wang Yanxi was killed by his subordinates Lian Chongyu and Zhu Wenjin; the multitude supported Wenjin to administer the post of military governor, adopted the Tianfu reign title, and reported by a secret route.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Min king Wang Yanxi was murdered by Lian Chongyu and Zhu Wenjin; the troops backed Wenjin as acting governor, kept the Tianfu era name, and sent word by a back road.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太子少傅盧文紀改太子太傅，太子少保李麟改太子太保，刑部尚書李懌改戶部尚書，給事中司徒詡改右散騎常侍，以府州刺史折從阮為安北都護，充振武節度使。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Lu Wenji, Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Li Lin, Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, was made Grand Guardian; Li Yi, Minister of Justice, was made Minister of Revenue; Situ Xu, Supervising Secretary, was made Right Regular Attendant of the Imperial Secretariat; Zhe Congruan, prefect of Fuzhou, was made Protector-General of Pacifying the North and military commissioner of Zhenwu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Lu Wenji rose from junior to grand tutor of the heir; Li Lin became grand guardian; Li Yi moved from Justice to Revenue; Situ Xu became right cavalier attendant; and Fuzhou prefect Zhe Congruan was named northern protector and Zhenwu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是夜，熒惑入南斗。

translations.literal: That night Mars entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: That night Mars entered the constellation of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔復置明經、童子二科。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict restored the two examination categories of Classics Specialist and Youth.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the throne restored the Classics Specialist and Youth civil-service categories.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以鄧州節度使王令溫為延州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Wang Lingwen, military commissioner of Dengzhou, was made military commissioner of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Dengzhou commissioner Wang Lingwen was transferred to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以威武軍兵馬留後、權知閩國事朱文進為檢校太傅、福州威武軍節度使，知閩國事。

translations.literal: On guichou, Zhu Wenjin, acting military governor of Weiwu Army and provisional administrator of Min affairs, was given the added title of Acting Grand Tutor, made military commissioner of the Weiwu Army at Fuzhou, and appointed to administer Min affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Zhu Wenjin, acting Weiwu commander and provisional ruler of Min, received acting Grand Tutor, became Fuzhou Weiwu commissioner, and continued to govern Min.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，升澶州為節鎮，以鎮寧為軍額，割濮州為屬郡。

translations.literal: On guihai, Chunzhou was elevated to a military commission, with Zhenning as the army designation; Puzhou was detached as a subordinate prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Chunzhou was raised to full military status under the Zhenning army name, with Puzhou placed under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以延州節度使史威為澶州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Shi Wei, military commissioner of Yanzhou, was made military commissioner of Chunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Yanzhou commissioner Shi Wei was appointed to Chunzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day (gengwu) of the ninth month there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: The new moon of the ninth month brought a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以戶部侍郎韋勛為太子賓客，以前棣州刺史段希堯為戶部侍郎，以光祿卿張仁願為大理卿。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Wei Xun, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Duan Xiyao, former prefect of Dizhou, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Zhang Renyuan, Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Wei Xun of Revenue became mentor to the heir; former Dizhou prefect Duan Xiyao became Revenue vice minister; and Zhang Renyuan of the Court of Imperial Entertainments became director of judicial review.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禮部侍郎符蒙卒。

translations.literal: On jichou, Fu Meng, Vice Minister of Rites, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Rites vice minister Fu Meng died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太原奏，代州刺史白文珂破契丹於七里烽，斬首千餘級，生擒將校七十餘人。

translations.literal: On renchen, Taiyuan reported that Bai Wenke, prefect of Daizhou, defeated the Khitan at Qili Beacon, beheaded more than a thousand, and captured alive more than seventy officers.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Taiyuan reported that Daizhou prefect Bai Wenke had routed the Khitan at Qili Beacon, taking more than a thousand heads and seventy officers alive.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以前隴州防禦使翟光鄴為宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: On guisi, Zhai Guangye, former defense commissioner of Longzhou, was made Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi former Longzhou defense commissioner Zhai Guangye became northern Palace Secretariat commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以滄州節度使王廷胤卒輟朝，贈中書令。

translations.literal: On jihai, because Wang Tingyin, military commissioner of Cangzhou, had died, court was suspended; he was posthumously given the title Palace Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai court mourning was observed for the death of Cangzhou commissioner Wang Tingyin, who was posthumously named Palace Attendant-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，兩浙節度使、吳越國王錢宏佐加守太尉。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on renyin, Qian Hongzuo, military commissioner of the Two Zhes and King of Wuyue, was given the added title of Acting Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on renyin, Wuyue king and Two Zhes commissioner Qian Hongzuo received acting Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以徐州節度使、北面行營馬步都虞候趙在禮為北面行營副都統，鄴都留守馬全節為北面行營副招討使。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Zhao Zaili, military commissioner of Xuzhou and chief inspector of horse and foot of the northern campaign headquarters, was made deputy overall commander of the northern headquarters; Ma Quanjie, military governor of Yedu, was made deputy chief commander of pacification.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zhao Zaili of Xuzhou became deputy northern commander, and Yedu governor Ma Quanjie became deputy chief pacification commander.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以起居郎、知制誥賈緯為戶部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Jia Wei, Recorder of the Emperor's Actions and Drafting Edict Drafter, was made Director of the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Edict Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin recorder and drafting drafter Jia Wei became Revenue director while keeping his drafting post.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔曰：

translations.literal: On wuwu, an edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the throne issued an edict:

sentences.zh: 朕虔承顧命，獲嗣丕基。

translations.literal: We reverently received the dying charge and obtained succession to the great foundation.
translations.idiomatic: We have reverently received the late emperor's charge and succeeded to the great foundation of the realm.

sentences.zh: 常懼顛危，不克負荷，宵分日昃，罔敢怠寧，夕惕晨興，每懷祗畏。

translations.literal: We constantly fear collapse and that we cannot bear the burden; from midnight until the sun declines we dare not slacken in repose; vigilant at evening and rising at dawn, we always harbor reverent awe.
translations.idiomatic: We live in constant fear of ruin and of failing to bear the burden; from midnight until sundown we dare not rest; each evening we take warning and each dawn we rise, ever mindful of reverent awe.

sentences.zh: 但以恩信未著，德教未敷，理道不明，咎征斯至。

translations.literal: Yet because favor and trust have not been made manifest, virtue and instruction have not been spread abroad, and the Way of governance is unclear, omens of blame have arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Yet because grace and trust have not been made clear, moral teaching has not spread, and the principles of rule remain obscure, signs of blame have come upon us.

sentences.zh: 向者，頻年災沴，稼穡不登，道堇相望，上天垂譴，涼德所招。

translations.literal: Recently, for successive years calamities and pestilence have occurred, the crops have not ripened, and corpses from starvation line the roads; Heaven has sent reproof—summoned by our meager virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years disasters and pestilence have followed one upon another, harvests have failed, and the starved lie unburied along the roads; Heaven's reproof reflects the weakness of our virtue.

sentences.zh: 仍屬干戈尚興，邊陲多事。

translations.literal: Moreover arms are still raised and the borderlands are beset with troubles.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover war still rages and the frontiers are in constant turmoil.

sentences.zh: 倉廩不足，則輟人之糇食；

translations.literal: When the granaries are insufficient, we take the people's dry provisions;
translations.idiomatic: When the granaries run short, we seize the people's grain;

sentences.zh: 帑藏不足，則率人之資財；

translations.literal: when the treasury is insufficient, we levy the people's wealth;
translations.idiomatic: when the treasury fails, we levy the people's wealth;

sentences.zh: 兵士不足，則取人之丁中；

translations.literal: when soldiers are insufficient, we take men from the registered households;
translations.idiomatic: when troops are lacking, we conscript men from the registers;

sentences.zh: 戰騎不足，則假人之乘馬。

translations.literal: when war horses are insufficient, we borrow the people's riding horses.
translations.idiomatic: when cavalry mounts fall short, we press the people's horses into service.

sentences.zh: 雖事不獲已，而理將若何！

translations.literal: Although these matters could not be avoided, what shall become of principle!
translations.idiomatic: Though such measures could not be avoided, what becomes of right principle!

sentences.zh: 訪聞差去使臣，殊乖體認，不有敦於勉諭，而乃臨以威刑，自有所聞，益深愧悼。

translations.literal: We have learned that the dispatched envoys have greatly departed from our intent: instead of earnestly exhorting and instructing, they have confronted the people with harsh punishments. Since we heard of this, our shame and grief have deepened.
translations.idiomatic: We have learned that the envoys we sent have grossly misunderstood our intent, threatening the people with harsh punishments rather than earnestly exhorting them; hearing of this, we are all the more ashamed and grieved.

sentences.zh: 旋屬守臣叛命，敵騎入邊，致使甲兵不暇休息，軍旅有征戰之苦，人民有飛免之勞，疲瘵未蘇，科徭尚急，言念於茲，寢食何安！

translations.literal: Soon afterward a frontier commander rebelled and enemy horsemen entered the border, so that armor and weapons had no time to rest; the armies suffered the hardships of campaign, and the people the toil of forced transport. The exhausted and sick have not yet recovered, yet levies and corvée remain urgent. When we speak of this, how can we eat or sleep in peace!
translations.idiomatic: Soon a frontier commander rebelled and enemy cavalry crossed the border, so that arms never rested, the armies knew campaign hardship, and the people bore the burden of urgent transport. The sick have not recovered, yet levies remain harsh. At the thought of this, how can we eat or sleep in peace!

sentences.zh: 得不省過興懷，側身罪已，載深減損，思召和平？

translations.literal: Should we not reflect on our faults and rouse our hearts, turn inward in self-reproach, greatly reduce expenditures, and seek to summon peace?
translations.idiomatic: Should we not examine our faults, reproach ourselves, cut our spending deeply, and seek to restore peace?

sentences.zh: 所宜去無用之資，罷不急之務，棄華取實，惜費省功，一則符先帝慈儉之規，一則慕前王樸素之德。

translations.literal: What is fitting is to remove useless expenditures, abolish non-urgent affairs, discard ornament for substance, cherish economy and save labor—on the one hand conforming to the late emperor's merciful frugality, on the other emulating the plain simplicity of former kings.
translations.idiomatic: We should cut useless spending, drop nonessential tasks, choose substance over display, and husband resources—honoring the late emperor's merciful frugality and the plain virtue of kings of old.

sentences.zh: 向者，造作軍器，破用稍多，但取堅剛，不須華楚；

translations.literal: Recently, in making military equipment, expenditures have been rather heavy; we need only sturdiness and strength, not lavish ornament;
translations.idiomatic: Recently arms manufacture has been costly; we need only strength and durability, not lavish decoration;

sentences.zh: 今後作坊制器械，不得更用金銀裝飾。

translations.literal: henceforth workshops making equipment must no longer use gold and silver decoration.
translations.idiomatic: from now on workshops must not adorn weapons with gold or silver.

sentences.zh: 比於遊畋，素非所好，凡諸服禦，尤欲去奢，應天下府州不得以珍寶玩好及鷹犬為貢。

translations.literal: As for hunting, it has never been to our taste; for all apparel and equipage we especially wish to remove extravagance. All prefectures throughout the realm must not present precious objects, curios, hawks, or hounds as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: We have never cared for the chase; for court dress and equipage we especially wish to strip away luxury. No prefecture in the realm may offer jewels, curios, hawks, or hounds as tribute.

sentences.zh: 在昔聖帝明君，無非惡衣菲食，況於薄德，所合恭行，今後大官尚膳，減去多品，衣服帷帳，務去華飾，在禦寒溫而已。

translations.literal: In former times sage emperors and enlightened rulers all wore coarse clothes and ate plain food; how much more should we of meager virtue respectfully practice this. Henceforth the Court of Imperial Entertainments shall reduce the variety of dishes; for clothing and curtains, strive to remove ornate decoration—sufficient only to guard against cold and heat.
translations.idiomatic: Sage rulers of old wore plain clothes and ate simple food; how much more should we of little virtue do the same. Henceforth the imperial kitchen shall serve fewer dishes; clothing and hangings shall shed ornament and serve only warmth and shelter.

sentences.zh: 峻宇雕墻，昔人所誡，玉杯象箸，前代攸非，今後凡有營繕之處，丹堊雕鏤，不得過度，宮闈之內，有非理費用，一切禁止。

translations.literal: Lofty halls and carved walls were warned against by men of old; jade cups and ivory chopsticks were condemned by former ages. Henceforth wherever construction is undertaken, cinnabar plaster and carved tracery must not be excessive; within the palace any unreasonable expenditure is altogether forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Lofty halls and carved walls were condemned by the ancients, as were jade cups and ivory chopsticks. Henceforth all building work must avoid excessive paint and carving, and every unreasonable expense within the palace is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 繼聖承祧，握樞臨極，昧於至道，若履春冰。

translations.literal: Succeeding the sage and receiving the ancestral line, holding the pivot and reaching the summit—we are obscure to the supreme Way, as if treading spring ice.
translations.idiomatic: Having succeeded the sage and received the ancestral line, we hold the throne yet are blind to the supreme Way, as if walking on spring ice.

sentences.zh: 屬以天災流行，國步多梗，因時致懼，引咎推誠，期於將來，庶幾有補。

translations.literal: Now that heavenly disasters prevail and the state's course is beset with obstacles, we take fear from the times, accept blame and offer sincerity, hoping that in the future there may perhaps be some remedy.
translations.idiomatic: With disasters abroad and the realm in peril, we take warning from the times, accept blame, and offer our sincerity, hoping the future may yet be set right.

sentences.zh: 更賴王公、將相，貴戚、豪宗，各啟乃心，率由茲道，共臻富庶，以致康寧。

translations.literal: We further rely on princes and dukes, generals and ministers, noble kin and great clans—each to open your hearts, follow this path, and together attain abundance and bring about peace and security.
translations.idiomatic: We call upon princes, ministers, noble kin, and great families alike to open your hearts, follow this course, and together bring prosperity and peace to the realm.

sentences.zh: 凡百臣僚，宜體朕意。

translations.literal: All officials should embody our intent.
translations.idiomatic: Let every official take this to heart.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，詔曰：「蕃寇未平，邊陲多事，即日雖無侵軼，亦須廣設提防。

translations.literal: On renshen in the eleventh month, an edict stated: "The barbarian raiders are not yet pacified and the borderlands are troubled. Although at present there is no invasion, defenses must still be broadly set in place."
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the eleventh month an edict declared: "The barbarian enemy is not yet subdued and the frontiers remain unsettled. Though there is no raid today, we must still prepare our defenses widely."

sentences.zh: 朕將親率虎貔，躬擐甲胄，候聞南牧，即便北征，不須先定日辰，別行告諭。

translations.literal: We shall personally lead the tiger guards and don armor ourselves; when word comes that the enemy has driven south to pasture, we shall at once march north. There is no need to fix a date in advance or issue a separate proclamation.
translations.idiomatic: We shall lead the army in person and buckle on armor; when word comes that the enemy is driving south, we shall march north at once without fixing a date in advance or issuing a separate notice.

sentences.zh: 所有供億，宜令三司預行計度，合隨從諸司職員，並宜常備行計」云。

translations.literal: All supplies should be ordered planned in advance by the Three Commissions; all officials of the relevant offices who are to accompany us should likewise keep travel plans in constant readiness."
translations.idiomatic: All supplies should be planned in advance by the Three Commissions, and every official of the accompanying offices should keep travel arrangements ready at all times."

sentences.zh: 己卯，以陳州刺史梁漢璋充侍衛馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On jimao, Liang Hanzhang, prefect of Chenzhou, was appointed overall commander of the Palace Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Chenzhou prefect Liang Hanzhang was made overall commander of the Palace Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以貝州節度使何建為澶州節度使兼北面行營馬軍右廂排陣使，以澶州節度使史威為貝州節度使。

translations.literal: On renwu, He Jian, military commissioner of Beizhou, was made military commissioner of Chunzhou and concurrently array marshal of the right wing of the cavalry of the northern headquarters; Shi Wei, military commissioner of Chunzhou, was made military commissioner of Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Beizhou commissioner He Jian became Chunzhou commissioner and cavalry right-wing array marshal of the northern headquarters, while Chunzhou commissioner Shi Wei was transferred to Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以前金州節度使田武為滄州節度使兼北面行營步軍右廂都指揮使，以前相州節度使郭謹為鄜州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Tian Wu, former military commissioner of Jinzhou, was made military commissioner of Cangzhou and concurrently overall commander of the right wing of the infantry of the northern headquarters; Guo Jin, former military commissioner of Xiangzhou, was made military commissioner of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu former Jinzhou commissioner Tian Wu became Cangzhou commissioner and infantry right-wing commander of the northern headquarters, and former Xiangzhou commissioner Guo Jin was appointed to Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥朔，幸臯門，射中白兔。

translations.literal: On the first day (jihai) of the twelfth month the Emperor visited Gao Gate and shot a white hare.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month the emperor visited Gao Gate and shot a white hare.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，福州節度使朱文進加同平章事，封閩國王。

translations.literal: On guichou, Zhu Wenjin, military commissioner of Fuzhou, was given the added title of Grand Councilor and enfeoffed as King of Min.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Fuzhou commissioner Zhu Wenjin was made grand councilor and enfeoffed as King of Min.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，青州楊光遠降。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Yang Guangyuan of Qingzhou surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Yang Guangyuan of Qingzhou surrendered.

sentences.zh: 光遠子承勛等斬觀察判官邱濤、牙將白延祚、楊贍、杜延壽等首級，送於招討使李守貞，乃縱火大噪，劫其父處於私第，以城納款，遣即墨縣令王德柔貢表待罪。

translations.literal: Guangyuan's sons Chengxun and others beheaded the observation commissioner aide Qiu Tao and the guard officers Bai Yanzuo, Yang Zhan, Du Yanshou, and others, and sent their heads to the pacification commissioner Li Shouzhen. They then set fires and raised a great clamor, seized their father and confined him in a private residence, surrendered the city, and sent Jimo county magistrate Wang Derou to present a memorial awaiting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyuan's sons Chengxun and the rest killed observation aide Qiu Tao and guard officers Bai Yanzuo, Yang Zhan, and Du Yanshou, sending their heads to pacification commissioner Li Shouzhen. They then set fires, raised an uproar, seized their father and held him in a private house, surrendered the city, and sent Jimo magistrate Wang Derou with a memorial awaiting judgment.

sentences.zh: 楊光遠亦遣節度判官楊麟奉表請死。

translations.literal: Yang Guangyuan also sent his military commissioner aide Yang Lin to present a memorial requesting death.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guangyuan also sent commissioner aide Yang Lin with a memorial asking to die.

sentences.zh: 詔釋之。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted him pardon.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚午，以楊承信為右羽林將軍，承祚為右驍騎衛將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu in the intercalary month, Yang Chengxin was made General of the Right Forest of Feathers Army, and Chengzuo was made General of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the intercalary month Yang Chengxin was made a general of the Right Forest of Feathers, and Chengzuo a general of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard.

sentences.zh: 皆光遠之子，先詣闕請罪，故特授是官。

translations.literal: Both were sons of Guangyuan who had first come to court to plead guilty; therefore they were specially granted these offices.
translations.idiomatic: Both were Guangyuan's sons who had come to court first to plead guilt, and were therefore specially given these posts.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，李守貞奏，楊光遠卒。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Li Shouzhen memorialized that Yang Guangyuan had died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Shouzhen reported that Yang Guangyuan was dead.

sentences.zh: 初，光遠既上表送降，帝以光遠頃歲太原歸命，欲曲全之，議者曰：「豈有反狀滔天而赦之也！

translations.literal: Initially, after Guangyuan had submitted his memorial of surrender, the Emperor, because Guangyuan had submitted to the throne at Taiyuan a few years before, wished to spare him entirely. Those who deliberated said: "How can there be treason reaching to heaven and yet pardon him!"
translations.idiomatic: When Guangyuan first submitted his surrender memorial, the emperor, remembering that he had submitted at Taiyuan only a few years earlier, wished to spare him. Counselors objected: "How can treason of such magnitude be pardoned!"

sentences.zh: 」乃命守貞便宜處置。

translations.literal: " He therefore ordered Shouzhen to dispose of the matter as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then ordered Shouzhen to deal with him as he saw fit.

sentences.zh: 守貞遣人拉殺之，以病卒聞。

translations.literal: Shouzhen sent men to strangle him to death and reported that he had died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Shouzhen had him strangled and reported that he had died of illness.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，前登州刺史張萬迪削奪官爵處斬，青州節度判官楊麟配流威州，掌書記任邈配流原州，支使徐晏配流武州。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Zhang Wandi, former prefect of Dengzhou, was stripped of rank and executed; Yang Lin, military commissioner aide of Qingzhou, was banished to Weizhou; Ren Miao, secretary, was banished to Yuanzhou; Xu Yan, administrative aide, was banished to Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou former Dengzhou prefect Zhang Wandi was stripped of rank and executed; Qingzhou aide Yang Lin was exiled to Weizhou; secretary Ren Miao to Yuanzhou; and administrative aide Xu Yan to Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 縱逢恩赦，不在放還之限，並以楊光遠叛故也。

translations.literal: Even if an amnesty should come, they were not within the scope of release—all because of Yang Guangyuan's rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Even future amnesties would not restore them, all on account of Yang Guangyuan's rebellion.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書、權知貢舉竇貞固奏：「試進士諸科舉人入策，舊例夜試，以三條燭盡為限，天成二年改令晝試，今欲依舊夜試。

translations.literal: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Works and acting Director of the Examination, memorialized: "For candidates of the Presented Scholar and other categories entering the policy examination, the old rule was night examination, limited by the burning of three candles. In the second year of Tiancheng it was changed to daytime examination; we now wish to restore night examination as before."
translations.idiomatic: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Works and acting examination director, reported that policy examinations for Presented Scholars and other candidates had formerly been held at night, limited by three candles; daytime exams were introduced in Tiancheng 2, and he asked to restore the night examination.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court accepted this.

sentences.zh: 曲赦青州管內罪人，立功將士各賜優給，青州吏民為楊光遠詿誤者，一切不問。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to criminals within Qingzhou's jurisdiction; meritorious officers and soldiers were each given generous rewards; officials and people of Qingzhou misled by Yang Guangyuan were altogether not questioned.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was declared for criminals in Qingzhou; meritorious troops received generous rewards; and officials and commoners led astray by Yang Guangyuan were not prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 青州行營招討使、兗州節度使兼侍衛都虞候李守貞加同平章事，副招討使、河陽節度使符彥卿改許州節度使。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen, pacification commissioner of the Qingzhou field headquarters, military commissioner of Yanzhou, and chief inspector of the Palace Guards, was given the added title of Grand Councilor; Fu Yanqing, deputy pacification commissioner and military commissioner of Heyang, was transferred to military commissioner of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen, Qingzhou pacification commissioner and Yanzhou military commissioner, was made grand councilor; deputy pacification commissioner Fu Yanqing of Heyang was transferred to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，降青州為防禦使額，以萊州刺史楊承勛為汝州防禦使。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Qingzhou was reduced to a defense command; Yang Chengxun, prefect of Laizhou, was made defense commissioner of Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Qingzhou was downgraded to a defense command, and Laizhou prefect Yang Chengxun was made defense commissioner of Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以工部尚書竇貞固為禮部尚書，太常卿王延為工部尚書，左丞王松為太常卿，以前尚書右丞龍敏為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: On jichou, Dou Zhengu, Minister of Works, was made Minister of Rites; Wang Yan, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Minister of Works; Wang Song, Left Vice Director, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Long Min, former Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Dou Zhengu moved from Works to Rites; Wang Yan from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to Works; Wang Song became director of that court; and former right vice director Long Min became left vice director.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以前安州防禦使李建崇為河陽兵馬留後，以宣徽使翟光鄴為青州防禦使，以內客省使李彥韜為宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: On guisi, Li Jianchong, former defense commissioner of Anzhou, was made acting military governor of Heyang; Zhai Guangye, Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat, was made defense commissioner of Qingzhou; Li Yantao, Commissioner of the Inner Guests Office, was made Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi former Anzhou defense commissioner Li Jianchong became acting Heyang commander; Zhai Guangye became Qingzhou defense commissioner; and Li Yantao of the Inner Guests Office became northern Palace Secretariat commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以給事中邊光範為左散騎常侍，以樞密直學士、吏部郎中李穀為給事中，依前充職。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Bian Guangfan, Supervising Secretary, was made Left Regular Attendant of the Imperial Secretariat; Li Gu, Academician Direct of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Supervising Secretary, continuing in his former duties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Bian Guangfan became left cavalier attendant; Li Gu of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Personnel became supervising secretary while retaining his former duties.

sentences.zh: 是月，契丹耶律德光與趙延壽領全軍入寇，圍恒州，分兵陷鼓城、槁城、元氏、高邑、昭慶、寧晉、蒲澤、欒城、柏鄉等縣，前鋒至邢州，河北諸州告急。

translations.literal: That month, Yelü Deguang of the Khitan and Zhao Yanshou led the full army in invasion, besieged Hengzhou, and sent detachments to capture Gucheng, Gaocheng, Yuanshi, Gaoyi, Zhaoqing, Ningjin, Puze, Luancheng, Baixiang, and other counties. The vanguard reached Xingzhou, and the prefectures of Hebei reported urgent distress.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Khitan Yelü Deguang and Zhao Yanshou invaded at the head of the full army, besieged Hengzhou, and sent columns to take Gucheng, Gaocheng, Yuanshi, Gaoyi, Zhaoqing, Ningjin, Puze, Luancheng, Baixiang, and other counties. The vanguard reached Xingzhou, and Hebei prefectures sent urgent alarms.

sentences.zh: 詔張從恩、馬全節、安審琦率師屯邢州，趙在禮屯鄴都。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zhang Cong'en, Ma Quanjie, and An Shenqi to lead armies and encamp at Xingzhou; Zhao Zaili encamped at Yedu.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Zhang Cong'en, Ma Quanjie, and An Shenqi to hold Xingzhou with their armies, and Zhao Zaili to hold Yedu.

sentences.zh: 開運二年春正月戊戌朔，帝不受朝賀，不豫故也。

translations.literal: On the first day (wuxu) of the first month of spring in the second year of Kaiyun, the Emperor did not receive court congratulations, because he was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month of spring in Kaiyun 2, the emperor declined the court's New Year felicitations because he was ill.

sentences.zh: 己亥，張從恩部領兵士自邢州退至相州，人情震恐。

translations.literal: On jihai, Zhang Cong'en led his troops in retreat from Xingzhou to Xiangzhou, and the people's spirits were shaken with fear.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zhang Cong'en withdrew his troops from Xingzhou to Xiangzhou, and public panic spread.

sentences.zh: 趙在禮還屯澶州，馬全節歸鄴都，遣右神武統軍張彥澤屯黎陽，詔西京留守景延廣將兵守胡梁渡。

translations.literal: Zhao Zaili returned to encamp at Chan Prefecture; Ma Quanjie returned to Yedu; the Right Divine Martial Commander-in-Chief Zhang Yanze was sent to encamp at Liyang; an edict ordered Western Capital regent Jing Yanguang to lead troops and guard Hubliang Ford.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zaili fell back to Chan Prefecture, Ma Quanjie to Yedu; Zhang Yanze as Right Divine Martial commander was posted at Liyang; and Jing Yanguang, regent of the Western Capital, was ordered to hold Hubliang Ford.

sentences.zh: 契丹寇邢州。

translations.literal: The Khitan raided Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan forces attacked Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 侍衛馬軍都指揮使梁漢璋改鄭州防禦使，典軍如故。

translations.literal: Liang Hanzhang, Commander of the Palace Attendant Cavalry, was transferred to defense commissioner of Zheng Prefecture, continuing in command of troops as before.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Hanzhang, commander of the palace cavalry, became defense commissioner of Zheng Prefecture while retaining troop command.

sentences.zh: 以齊州防禦使劉在明為相州留後。

translations.literal: Liu Zaiming, defense commissioner of Qi Prefecture, was made acting governor of Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zaiming, defense commissioner of Qi Prefecture, was appointed acting governor of Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以客省使孟承誨為內客省使。

translations.literal: On guimao, Meng Chenghui, Commissioner of Receiving Envoys, was made Inner Commissioner of Receiving Envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Meng Chenghui was promoted from outer to inner commissioner of receiving envoys.

sentences.zh: 滑州奏，今月二日至四日，相州路烽火不至。

translations.literal: Hua Prefecture reported that from the second to the fourth of this month, beacon fires on the Xiang Prefecture route did not arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Hua Prefecture reported that from the second through the fourth of the month no beacon signals came through on the Xiang Prefecture line.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以前汝州防禦使宋光鄴為左驍衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Song Guangye, former defense commissioner of Ru Prefecture, was made Grand General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen former Ru Prefecture defense commissioner Song Guangye became grand general of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard.

sentences.zh: 詔青州行營將校，自副兵馬使以上，各賜功臣名號。

translations.literal: An edict granted merit titles to the officers of the Qingzhou field headquarters, from deputy commanders of horse and foot upward.
translations.idiomatic: Officers of the Qingzhou field headquarters, from deputy horse-and-foot commanders up, were each granted merit titles.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，帝復常膳。

translations.literal: On yisi, the Emperor resumed his normal meals.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the emperor resumed his normal diet.

sentences.zh: 以左武衛上將軍袁{山義}為客省使，上將軍如故。

translations.literal: Yuan Shanyi, Senior General of the Left Martial Guard, was made Commissioner of Receiving Envoys, retaining his rank as senior general.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shanyi, senior general of the Left Martial Guard, was made commissioner of receiving envoys while keeping his general's rank.

sentences.zh: 詔滑州節度使皇甫遇率兵赴邢州，馬全節赴相州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Huangfu Yu, military commissioner of Hua Prefecture, to lead troops to Xingzhou, and Ma Quanjie to Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Yu of Hua Prefecture was ordered to Xingzhou with his troops, and Ma Quanjie to Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 契丹寇洺、磁，犯鄴都西北界，所在告急。

translations.literal: The Khitan raided Mo and Ci Prefectures, violated the northwestern border of Yedu, and everywhere sent urgent reports.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan raiders struck Mo and Ci, crossed into Yedu's northwestern marches, and alarms poured in from every quarter.

sentences.zh: 壬子，王師與契丹相拒於相州北安陽河上，皇甫遇、慕容彥超率前鋒與敵騎戰於榆林店，遇馬中流矢，僅而獲免。

translations.literal: On renzi, the imperial army confronted the Khitan north of Xiang Prefecture on the Anyang River; Huangfu Yu and Murong Yanchao led the vanguard against enemy cavalry at Yulin Post; Yu's horse was struck by a flying arrow, and he barely escaped.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the imperial army faced the Khitan north of Xiang Prefecture along the Anyang River. Huangfu Yu and Murong Yanchao's vanguard clashed with enemy horsemen at Yulin Post; Yu's mount took an arrow and he barely got away.

sentences.zh: （《遼史》：皇甫遇與濮州刺史慕容彥超將兵千騎，來覘遼軍。

translations.literal: (History of Liao: Huangfu Yu and Puzhou prefect Murong Yanchao led a thousand horse, coming to reconnoiter the Liao army.
translations.idiomatic: (History of Liao: Huangfu Yu and Murong Yanchao, prefect of Puzhou, led a thousand horsemen to scout the Liao forces.

sentences.zh: 至鄴都，遇遼軍數萬，且戰且卻，至榆林店，遼軍繼至，遇與彥超力戰百餘合，遇馬斃步戰，安審琦引騎兵逾水以救，遼軍乃還。）〉

translations.literal: At Yedu they met tens of thousands of Liao troops, fighting as they withdrew; at Yulin Post the Liao army followed up; Yu and Yanchao fought fiercely for more than a hundred rounds; Yu's horse fell and he fought on foot; An Shenqi led cavalry across the water to rescue them, and the Liao army then withdrew.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Near Yedu they ran into tens of thousands of Liao troops and fought retreating step by step. At Yulin Post the Liao pressed close; Yu and Yanchao battled hard for over a hundred engagements. When Yu's horse was killed he fought on foot until An Shenqi forded the river with cavalry to relieve them, and the Liao then pulled back.)〉

sentences.zh: 是夜，張從恩引軍退保黎陽，唯留五百人守安陽河橋。

translations.literal: That night, Zhang Cong'en led his army in retreat to hold Liyang, leaving only five hundred men to guard the Anyang River bridge.
translations.idiomatic: That night Zhang Cong'en withdrew to Liyang, leaving only five hundred men to hold the Anyang River bridge.

sentences.zh: 既而知州符彥倫與軍校謀曰：「此夜紛紜，人無固誌，五百疲兵，安能守橋！

translations.literal: Thereupon Prefect Fu Yanlun and a military officer plotted, saying, "This night is chaotic; men have no firm resolve—how can five hundred weary soldiers hold the bridge!
translations.idiomatic: Then prefect Fu Yanlun and his officers conferred: "The night is in uproar and morale is shaky—five hundred worn-out men cannot hold a bridge!

sentences.zh: 」即抽入相州，嬰城為備。

translations.literal: " They immediately withdrew into Xiang Prefecture and closed the city to prepare defenses.
translations.idiomatic: " They pulled back into Xiang Prefecture and shut the walls to prepare a defense.

sentences.zh: 至曙，賊軍萬餘騎已陣於安陽河北，彥倫令城上揚旗鼓噪，賊不之測。

translations.literal: At dawn, more than ten thousand enemy horsemen had already formed battle lines north of the Anyang River; Yanlun ordered drums and banners raised on the walls with a great clamor, and the enemy could not gauge their strength.
translations.idiomatic: By dawn over ten thousand enemy horsemen had lined up north of the Anyang River. Yanlun had drums beaten and banners raised on the walls in a great din, and the raiders could not tell what they faced.

sentences.zh: 至辰時，渡河而南，悉陣甲騎於城下，如攻城之狀。

translations.literal: By the chen hour they crossed the river southward and arrayed all armored cavalry below the walls as if to assault the city.
translations.idiomatic: Around mid-morning they forded south and deployed their armored horse below the walls as though preparing an assault.

sentences.zh: 彥倫曰：「此敵將走矣。

translations.literal: Yanlun said, "These enemies are about to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Yanlun said, "The enemy is about to pull out.

sentences.zh: 」乃出甲士五百於城北，張弓弩以待之，契丹果引去。

translations.literal: " He then sent out five hundred armored soldiers north of the city, strung bows and crossbows, and waited; the Khitan indeed withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: " He sent five hundred armored men out north of the city, drew bows and crossbows, and waited—and the Khitan did withdraw.

sentences.zh: 當皇甫遇榆林戰時，至晚敵眾自相驚曰：「晉軍悉至矣。

translations.literal: During Huangfu Yu's battle at Yulin, by evening the enemy masses alarmed one another, saying, "The Jin armies have all arrived!
translations.idiomatic: While Huangfu Yu was fighting at Yulin, by evening the enemy ranks began frightening one another: "All the Jin armies are here!

sentences.zh: 」戎王在邯鄲聞之，即時北遁，官軍亦南保黎陽。

translations.literal: " The barbarian king, at Handan, heard this and immediately fled north; the official army also withdrew south to hold Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: " Hearing this at Handan, the Khitan ruler fled north at once, and the imperial troops likewise fell back south to Liyang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以河陽留後李建崇為邢州留後，以鳳州防禦使

translations.literal: On jiayin, Li Jianchong, acting governor of Heyang, was made acting governor of Xing Prefecture, and the defense commissioner of Feng Prefecture
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Li Jianchong, acting governor of Heyang, became acting governor of Xing Prefecture, and the Feng Prefecture defense commissioner

sentences.zh: （案：此下有闕文。）〉

translations.literal: (Note: Below this there is missing text in the original.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Note: Text is missing below in the original.)〉

sentences.zh: 為河陽留後。

translations.literal: was made acting governor of Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: was appointed acting governor of Heyang.

sentences.zh: 詔李守貞領兵屯滑州，以宣徽北院使李彥韜權侍衛馬步都虞候。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Shouzhen to lead troops and encamp at Hua Prefecture; Li Yantao, Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat, was made acting Chief Inspector of the Palace Attendant Horse and Foot.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen was ordered to hold Hua Prefecture with his troops, and Li Yantao of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat was made acting chief inspector of the palace horse and foot.

sentences.zh: 改諸道武定軍為天威軍。

translations.literal: The Wuding Armies of the various circuits were renamed the Tianwei Army.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuding Armies of every circuit were renamed the Heavenly Might Army.

sentences.zh: 己未，以前許州節度使李從溫為北面行營都招撫使，以鄆州節度使張從恩權東京留守。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Li Congwen, former military commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was made Overall Pacification Commissioner of the Northern Field Headquarters; Zhang Cong'en, military commissioner of Yan Prefecture, was made acting Eastern Capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei former Xu Prefecture commissioner Li Congwen became overall pacification commissioner of the northern field headquarters, and Yan Prefecture commissioner Zhang Cong'en acting regent of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，相州奏，契丹抽退，其鄉村避寇百姓，已發遣各歸本家營種。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Xiang Prefecture reported that the Khitan had withdrawn; the common people of villages who had fled the bandits had been sent back each to their own homes to resume farming.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Xiang Prefecture reported that the Khitan had pulled back and that villagers who had fled the raids were being sent home to resume their planting.

sentences.zh: 初，帝以不豫初平，未任親禦軍旅，既而張從恩、馬全節相次奏賊軍充斥，恒州杜威告事勢危急，帝曰：「北敵未平，固難安寢，當悉眾一戰，以救朔方生靈。

translations.literal: Earlier, because the Emperor had only just recovered from illness, he was not yet fit to command the armies in person; then Zhang Cong'en and Ma Quanjie in succession reported that bandit armies filled the land, and Du Wei of Heng Prefecture reported that the situation was critically urgent; the Emperor said, "The northern enemy is not yet subdued—how can I rest in peace? We should marshal all forces for one battle to save the people of the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: At first, having only just recovered from illness, the emperor was not yet equal to leading the armies himself. Then Zhang Cong'en and Ma Quanjie reported in turn that enemy forces were everywhere, and Du Wei at Heng Prefecture warned that the crisis was acute. The emperor said, "While the northern foe is unbeaten I cannot lie easy. We must throw our full strength into one fight to save the people of the north.

sentences.zh: 若宴安遲疑，則大河以北，淪為寇壤矣。

translations.literal: If we feast in ease and hesitate, then north of the Great River all will become bandit territory.
translations.idiomatic: If we linger in comfort and doubt, everything north of the Yellow River will fall to the invaders.

sentences.zh: 」即日命諸將點閱，以定行計。

translations.literal: " That same day he ordered the generals to muster and review troops to fix the march plan.
translations.idiomatic: " That same day he ordered the generals to muster their troops and settle the campaign plan.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，下詔親征。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict was issued for the Emperor's personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict announced the emperor's personal expedition.

sentences.zh: 誅楊光遠部下指揮使張迥等五人，以戎事方興，慮其扇搖故也。

translations.literal: Five men including Commander Zhang Jiong, subordinates of Yang Guangyuan, were executed, because military affairs were just arising and there was fear they might incite unrest.
translations.idiomatic: Five officers under Yang Guangyuan, including Zhang Jiong, were executed for fear that with war under way they might stir up trouble.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以樞密直學士李穀為三司副使，判留司三司公事。

translations.literal: On guihai, Li Gu, Academician Direct of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Vice Commissioner of the Three Commissions, overseeing the affairs of the Three Commissions left behind at court.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Li Gu, academician direct of the Bureau of Military Affairs, became vice commissioner of the Three Commissions, overseeing the commissions' affairs left at court.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，車駕發離京師。

translations.literal: On yichou, the imperial carriage departed the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the emperor left the capital.

sentences.zh: 是月，京城北壕春冰之上有文，若大樹花葉，凡數十株，宛若圖畫，觀者如堵。

translations.literal: That month, on the spring ice of the northern moat of the capital there appeared patterns like the flowers and leaves of great trees—several dozen in all—just like paintings; onlookers packed the scene like a wall.
translations.idiomatic: That month patterns like the blossoms and leaves of great trees—several dozen of them—appeared on the spring ice of the capital's northern moat, as vivid as painted scrolls; crowds of onlookers packed the banks.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰朔，車駕次滑州。

translations.literal: On the first day (wuchen) of the second month, the imperial carriage halted at Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the second month the emperor stopped at Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己巳，渡浮橋，幸黎陽勞軍，至晚還滑州。

translations.literal: On jisi, he crossed the pontoon bridge, visited Liyang to encourage the army, and returned to Hua Prefecture in the evening.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he crossed the pontoon bridge, went to Liyang to review the troops, and returned to Hua Prefecture that evening.

sentences.zh: 以滄州節度使田武充東北面行營都部署。

translations.literal: Tian Wu, military commissioner of Cang Prefecture, was made Overall Commander of the Eastern-Northern Field Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Cang Prefecture commissioner Tian Wu was appointed overall commander of the eastern-northern field headquarters.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，幸澶州，以景延廣為隨駕馬步軍都鈐轄。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, he visited Chan Prefecture; Jing Yanguang was made Overall Commander of the Horse and Foot accompanying the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he went to Chan Prefecture and made Jing Yanguang overall commander of the horse and foot in the imperial train.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大閱諸軍於戚城，帝親臨之。

translations.literal: On bingzi, a grand review of the armies was held at Qicheng; the Emperor personally attended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the armies were reviewed at Qicheng with the emperor present.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，北面行營副招討使馬全節、行營都監李守貞、右神武統軍張彥澤等以前軍先發。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Ma Quanjie, Deputy Pacification Commissioner of the Northern Field Headquarters; Li Shouzhen, Inspector-General of the Field Headquarters; Zhang Yanze, Right Divine Martial Commander-in-Chief; and others led the advance guard out first.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Ma Quanjie as deputy pacification commissioner of the northern field headquarters, Li Shouzhen as field inspector-general, Zhang Yanze as Right Divine Martial commander, and others marched out first with the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以許州節度使符彥卿為北面行營馬軍都指揮使，以左神武統軍潘環為北面行營步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On jimao, Fu Yanqing, military commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was made Commander of the Cavalry of the Northern Field Headquarters; Pan Huan, Left Divine Martial Commander-in-Chief, was made Commander of the Infantry of the Northern Field Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Xu Prefecture commissioner Fu Yanqing became cavalry commander of the northern field headquarters, and Left Divine Martial commander Pan Huan infantry commander.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，幸楊村故壘。

translations.literal: On xinsi, he visited the old fortifications at Yang Village.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he inspected the old encampment at Yang Village.

sentences.zh: 符彥卿、皇甫遇、李殷率諸軍進發。

translations.literal: Fu Yanqing, Huangfu Yu, and Li Yin led the armies forward.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yanqing, Huangfu Yu, and Li Yin advanced with the main force.

sentences.zh: 以左散騎常侍邊光範為樞密直學士。

translations.literal: Bian Guangfan, Left Regular Attendant of the Imperial Cavalry, was made Academician Direct of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Guangfan, left cavalier attendant, was made academician direct of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔河北諸州，應蕃騎經由之地，吏民遭殺害者，委所在收瘞，量事祭奠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the prefectures of Hebei that where Khitan cavalry had passed and officials or common people had been killed, the local authorities were to gather and bury the dead and offer sacrifices as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei prefectures were ordered that wherever Khitan horsemen had passed and officials or civilians had been killed, local authorities should gather and bury the dead and make fitting offerings.

sentences.zh: 詔恒州杜威與馬全節等會合進軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Du Wei of Heng Prefecture to join Ma Quanjie and the others and advance together.
translations.idiomatic: Du Wei at Heng Prefecture was ordered to link up with Ma Quanjie and the rest and push forward.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，幸鐵丘閱馬，因幸趙在禮、李從溫軍。

translations.literal: On bingxu, he visited Tieqiu to review horses, and then visited the armies of Zhao Zaili and Li Congwen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he reviewed horses at Tieqiu and then inspected the camps of Zhao Zaili and Li Congwen.

sentences.zh: 是日大雪。

translations.literal: That day there was heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: Snow fell heavily that day.

sentences.zh: 戊子，安審琦、梁漢璋領兵北征。

translations.literal: On wuzi, An Shenqi and Liang Hanzhang led troops on the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi An Shenqi and Liang Hanzhang marched north.

sentences.zh: 府州防禦使折從阮奏，部領兵士攻圍契丹勝州，降之，見進兵趨朔州。

translations.literal: Zhe Congruan, defense commissioner of Fu Prefecture, reported that he had led troops to attack and besiege the Khitan Sheng Prefecture, which surrendered; he reported that he was advancing toward Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Prefecture defense commissioner Zhe Congruan reported that his troops had besieged and taken the Khitan prefecture of Sheng and were now advancing on Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以河中節度使安審琦為北面行營馬步軍都虞候，許州節度使符彥卿充馬步軍左廂都指揮使，滑州節度使皇甫遇充馬步軍右廂都指揮使，侍衛馬軍都指揮使梁漢璋充馬軍左右廂都指揮使，侍衛步軍都指揮使李殷充步軍左右廂都指揮使，左神武統軍張彥澤充馬軍左右廂都排陣使，右神武統軍潘環充步軍左右廂排陣使。

translations.literal: On jiawu, An Shenqi, military commissioner of Hezhong, was made Chief Inspector of the Horse and Foot of the Northern Field Headquarters; Fu Yanqing, military commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was made Overall Commander of the Left Wing of the Horse and Foot; Huangfu Yu, military commissioner of Hua Prefecture, was made Overall Commander of the Right Wing of the Horse and Foot; Liang Hanzhang, Commander of the Palace Attendant Cavalry, was made Overall Commander of the Left and Right Wings of the Cavalry; Li Yin, Commander of the Palace Attendant Infantry, was made Overall Commander of the Left and Right Wings of the Infantry; Zhang Yanze, Left Divine Martial Commander-in-Chief, was made Array Marshal of the Left and Right Wings of the Cavalry; Pan Huan, Right Divine Martial Commander-in-Chief, was made Array Marshal of the Left and Right Wings of the Infantry.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Hezhong commissioner An Shenqi became chief inspector of the northern field horse and foot; Xu commissioner Fu Yanqing overall commander of the left wing; Hua commissioner Huangfu Yu overall commander of the right wing; palace cavalry commander Liang Hanzhang overall commander of both cavalry wings; palace infantry commander Li Yin overall commander of both infantry wings; Left Divine Martial commander Zhang Yanze array marshal of both cavalry wings; and Right Divine Martial commander Pan Huan array marshal of both infantry wings.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以端明殿學士、尚書戶部侍郎馮玉為戶部尚書，充樞密使。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Feng Yu, Academician of the Duanming Hall and Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue, was made Minister of Revenue and appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Duanming Hall academician and Vice Minister of Revenue Feng Yu became Minister of Revenue and commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，契丹陷祁州，刺史沈斌死之。

translations.literal: On wuxu in the third month, the Khitan captured Qizhou; Prefect Shen Bin died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the third month the Khitan took Qizhou; prefect Shen Bin was killed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，左補闕袁範先陷契丹，自賊中逃歸。

translations.literal: On yisi, Left Remonstrance Adviser Yuan Fan, who had earlier fallen to the Khitan, escaped from the bandits and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Left Remonstrance Adviser Yuan Fan, who had earlier been captured by the Khitan, escaped and made his way back.

sentences.zh: 杜威奏，與李守貞、馬全節、安審琦、皇甫遇部領大軍赴定州。

translations.literal: Du Wei reported that he, together with Li Shouzhen, Ma Quanjie, An Shenqi, and Huangfu Yu, were leading the great army toward Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Du Wei reported that he was marching on Ding Prefecture at the head of the main army with Li Shouzhen, Ma Quanjie, An Shenqi, and Huangfu Yu.

sentences.zh: 易州刺史安審約奏，二月三日夜，差壯丁斫敵營，殺敵十餘人。

translations.literal: An Shenyao, prefect of Yi Prefecture, reported that on the third night of the second month he sent strong youths to cut into the enemy camp and killed more than ten of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Prefecture prefect An Shenyao reported that on the night of the third of the second month he sent stalwart men to raid the enemy camp and killed more than ten of them.

sentences.zh: 是日，以符彥卿為北面行營馬步軍左右廂都排陣使，以皇甫遇為北面行營馬步軍左廂排陣使，以王周為馬步軍右廂排陣使。

translations.literal: That day, Fu Yanqing was made Array Marshal of the Left and Right Wings of the Horse and Foot of the Northern Field Headquarters; Huangfu Yu was made Array Marshal of the Left Wing of the Horse and Foot of the Northern Field Headquarters; Wang Zhou was made Array Marshal of the Right Wing of the Horse and Foot.
translations.idiomatic: That day Fu Yanqing became array marshal of both horse-and-foot wings of the northern field headquarters; Huangfu Yu array marshal of the left wing; and Wang Zhou array marshal of the right wing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，畋於戚城，還幸景延廣、安審信軍。

translations.literal: On dingwei, he hunted at Qicheng, then visited the armies of Jing Yanguang and An Shenxin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he hunted at Qicheng, then inspected the camps of Jing Yanguang and An Shenxin.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，王師攻泰州，刺史晉庭謙以城降。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the imperial army attacked Taizhou; Prefect Jin Tingqian surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the imperial army attacked Taizhou, and prefect Jin Tingqian surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 易州奏，郎山塞將孫方簡破契丹千餘人，斬蕃將諧裏相公，擄其妻以獻。

translations.literal: Yi Prefecture reported that Sun Fangjian, garrison commander of Langshan Pass, defeated more than a thousand Khitan, beheaded the Khitan general Xieli Xianggong, and captured his wife to present as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Prefecture reported that Langshan Pass commander Sun Fangjian routed over a thousand Khitan, killed the Khitan general Xieli Xianggong, and sent back his captured wife as tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，杜威奏，收復滿城，獲契丹首領沒剌相公，並蕃漢兵士二千人。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Du Wei reported the recovery of Mancheng, the capture of the Khitan chieftain Mo-la Xianggong, and two thousand Khitan and Han soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Du Wei reported retaking Mancheng, capturing the Khitan chieftain Mo-la Xianggong, and two thousand Khitan and Han troops.

sentences.zh: 以前戶部尚書李懌為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Li Yi, former Minister of Revenue, was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Former Minister of Revenue Li Yi became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，杜威奏，收復遂城。

translations.literal: On yimao, Du Wei reported the recovery of Suicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Du Wei reported retaking Suicheng.

sentences.zh: 丙辰奏，大軍自遂城卻退至滿城。

translations.literal: On bingchen it was reported that the great army had retreated from Suicheng back to Mancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen word came that the main army had fallen back from Suicheng to Mancheng.

sentences.zh: 時賊將趙延壽部曲來降，言：「契丹主昨至古北口，幽州走報，漢軍大下，收卻泰州。

translations.literal: At that time troops under the bandit general Zhao Yanshou came over in surrender, saying, "Yesterday the Khitan ruler reached Gubei Pass; Youzhou sent urgent reports that Han armies were descending in force and had retaken Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: At that time men under the defector Zhao Yanshou surrendered and said, "Yesterday the Khitan ruler reached Gubei Pass. Youzhou sent urgent word that Han armies were marching south in strength and had retaken Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 尋下令諸部，令輜重入塞，輕騎卻回。

translations.literal: Soon orders were issued to the various divisions to send baggage trains into the frontier passes and withdraw the light cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Orders soon went out to every division to send the baggage train back through the passes and pull the light horse away.

sentences.zh: 戎王率五萬餘騎，來勢極盛，明日前鋒必至，請為之備。

translations.literal: The barbarian king is leading more than fifty thousand horsemen, and his approach is extremely strong; the vanguard will certainly arrive tomorrow—please prepare against it.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler is coming at the head of more than fifty thousand horsemen with overwhelming force; the vanguard will be here tomorrow—prepare for it.

sentences.zh: 」杜威、李守貞謀曰：「我師糧運不繼，深入賊疆，而逢大敵，亡之道也。

translations.literal: " Du Wei and Li Shouzhen plotted together, saying, "Our army's grain supply cannot keep up; we have penetrated deep into bandit territory and now face a great enemy—this is the road to destruction.
translations.idiomatic: " Du Wei and Li Shouzhen conferred: "Our supplies cannot keep pace; we are deep in enemy country and now face a major force—that is the path to ruin.

sentences.zh: 不如退還泰州，觀其兵勢強弱而禦之。

translations.literal: It would be better to withdraw to Taizhou, observe the strength or weakness of their forces, and then defend accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Better to fall back to Taizhou, gauge their strength, and meet them from there.

sentences.zh: 」軍士皆以為然。

translations.literal: " The soldiers all agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " The troops all agreed.

sentences.zh: 是日，還滿城。

translations.literal: That day they returned to Mancheng.
translations.idiomatic: That day they fell back to Mancheng.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，至泰州。

translations.literal: On dingsi, they reached Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi they reached Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，契丹前鋒已至。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Khitan vanguard had already arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Khitan vanguard was already on the field.

sentences.zh: 己未，大軍發泰州而南，契丹踵其後。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the great army set out south from Taizhou, and the Khitan followed close behind.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the main army marched south from Taizhou with the Khitan close on their heels.

sentences.zh: 是日，次陽城。

translations.literal: That day they halted at Yangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: That day they encamped at Yangcheng.

sentences.zh: 庚申，敵騎如墻而來，我步軍為方陣以禦之。

translations.literal: On gengshen, enemy cavalry came on like a wall; our infantry formed square arrays to meet them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen enemy horsemen bore down like a moving wall, and our infantry drew up in square formations to receive them.

sentences.zh: 選勁騎擊賊，鬥二十餘合，南行十餘里，賊勢稍卻，渡白溝而去。

translations.literal: Selected crack cavalry struck the bandits; after more than twenty rounds of fighting they marched south more than ten li; the bandits' momentum slackened somewhat, and they crossed the Baigou and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Crack cavalry were sent to hit the enemy; after more than twenty clashes the army marched south for over ten li, the enemy pressure eased, and they crossed the Baigou and pulled away.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，杜威召諸將議曰：「戎首自來，實為敵，若不血戰，吾輩何以求免。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Du Wei summoned the generals to confer, saying, "The barbarian chief has come in person—he is truly the enemy; if we do not fight a bloody battle, how can any of us hope to escape?
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Du Wei called the generals together and said, "The Khitan ruler has come himself—the real enemy is here. Unless we fight to the blood, none of us will get out alive.

sentences.zh: 」諸將然之。

translations.literal: " The generals agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " The generals agreed.

sentences.zh: 是日，敵騎還繞官軍，相去數里。

translations.literal: That day enemy cavalry circled back around the official army, several li apart.
translations.idiomatic: That day enemy horsemen wheeled around the imperial army, keeping several li away.

sentences.zh: 明日，我軍成列而行，蕃漢轉鬥，殺聲震地，才行十餘里，軍中人馬饑乏。

translations.literal: The next day our army marched in formation; Khitan and Han fought back and forth, and the cries of killing shook the earth; they had gone only a little more than ten li when men and horses in the army were hungry and exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the army marched in column while Khitan and Han forces clashed repeatedly and the battle cries shook the ground; after barely ten li men and horses were starving and spent.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，大軍至白團衛村下營。

translations.literal: On guihai, the great army reached Baituanwei Village and made camp.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the main army encamped at Baituanwei Village.

sentences.zh: 人馬俱渴，營中掘井，及水輒壞，兵士取其泥絞汁而飲。

translations.literal: Men and horses alike were parched; wells were dug in camp, but as soon as water was reached the walls collapsed; soldiers squeezed juice from the mud and drank it.
translations.idiomatic: Men and horses were alike parched; wells dug in camp collapsed as soon as water was struck, and soldiers squeezed moisture from the mud and drank it.

sentences.zh: 敵眾圍繞，漸束其營。

translations.literal: The enemy masses surrounded them and gradually tightened the ring around the camp.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy forces surrounded them and slowly tightened the noose around the camp.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·藥元福傳》：晉師列方陣，設拒馬為行寨，契丹以奇兵出陣後，斷糧道。）〉

translations.literal: (Biography of Yao Yuanfu in the History of Song: the Jin army formed square arrays and set abatis as a marching camp; the Khitan sent an unexpected force out behind the array and cut the supply route.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Yao Yuanfu: the Jin army drew up in square formations with abatis for a marching camp; the Khitan sent a flanking force behind the lines and severed the supply route.)〉

sentences.zh: 是日，東北風猛，揚塵折樹。

translations.literal: That day a fierce northeast wind blew, raising dust and snapping trees.
translations.idiomatic: That day a fierce northeast wind whipped up dust and snapped trees.

sentences.zh: 契丹主坐車中謂眾曰：「漢軍盡來，只有此耳，今日並可生擒，然後平定天下。

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler, seated in his carriage, said to the masses, "All the Han armies have come—there is only this force; today we can capture them all alive, and then pacify the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Seated in his carriage, the Khitan ruler told his men, "Every Han army is here, and this is all there is. Today we can take them all alive and then settle the realm.

sentences.zh: 」令下馬拔鹿角，飛矢雨集。

translations.literal: " He ordered them to dismount and pull up the abatis; flying arrows fell like rain.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered his men to dismount and tear up the abatis, and arrows fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 軍士大呼曰：「招討使何不用軍，而令士卒虛死！

translations.literal: The soldiers shouted loudly, saying, "Pacification Commissioner, why do you not deploy the army and instead let the troops die for nothing!
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers shouted, "Pacification Commissioner, why won't you commit the army and let us die for nothing!

sentences.zh: 」諸將鹹請擊之。

translations.literal: " All the generals earnestly requested an attack.
translations.idiomatic: The generals all pressed for an attack.

sentences.zh: 杜威曰：「俟風勢稍慢，觀其進退。

translations.literal: Du Wei said: "Wait until the wind slackens somewhat and observe whether they advance or retreat."
translations.idiomatic: Du Wei said, "Wait until the wind eases and watch whether they advance or pull back."

sentences.zh: 」守貞曰：「此風助我也。

translations.literal: " Shouzhen said: "This wind is helping us."
translations.idiomatic: Shouzhen said, "This wind is on our side."

sentences.zh: 彼眾我寡，黑風之內，莫測多少，若候風止，我輩無噍類矣。

translations.literal: They are many and we are few; within this black wind no one can tell their numbers. If we wait for the wind to stop, none of us will survive.
translations.idiomatic: They outnumber us, and in this black wind no one can tell how many they are. If we wait for the wind to die, none of us will get out alive.

sentences.zh: 」即呼眾軍齊力擊賊。

translations.literal: " He immediately called on the whole army to strike the enemy with united force.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered the whole army to attack together.

sentences.zh: 張彥澤、符彥卿、皇甫遇等率騎奮擊，風勢尤猛，沙塵如夜，敵遂大敗。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanzhe, Fu Yanqing, Huangfu Yu, and others led the cavalry in a fierce charge; the wind grew still fiercer and sand and dust were like night, and the enemy suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanzhe, Fu Yanqing, Huangfu Yu, and others led the cavalry in a furious charge through a wind so fierce that sand and dust turned day to night, and the enemy was routed.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·符彥卿傳》：時晉師居下風，將戰，弓弩莫施。

translations.literal: (Biography of Fu Yanqing in the History of Song: at the time the Jin army was downwind; as battle was about to begin, bows and crossbows could not be used.)
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Fu Yanqing: the Jin army was downwind and could not use bows or crossbows as battle was joined.)

sentences.zh: 彥卿謂張彥澤、皇甫遇曰：「與其束手就擒，曷若死戰，然未必死。

translations.literal: Yanqing said to Zhang Yanzhe and Huangfu Yu: "Rather than wait to be captured, how much better to fight to the death—yet we may not die after all."
translations.idiomatic: Yanqing told Zhang Yanzhe and Huangfu Yu, "Better to die fighting than be taken—and we may not die at all."

sentences.zh: 」彥澤然之，遂潛兵尾其後，順風擊之，契丹大敗。

translations.literal: " Yanzhe agreed; they then secretly sent troops to follow behind the enemy and struck with the wind, and the Khitan suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhe agreed, sent troops around behind the enemy, struck with the wind, and routed the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 又，《藥元福傳》：守貞與元福謀曰：「軍中饑渴已甚，若候風反出戰，吾屬為虜矣。

translations.literal: Moreover, Biography of Yao Yuanfu: Shouzhen and Yuanfu plotted together, saying: "The army is already desperately hungry and thirsty; if we wait for the wind to turn before fighting, we shall all be captives."
translations.idiomatic: Biography of Yao Yuanfu adds that Shouzhen and Yuanfu said, "The army is starving and parched; if we wait for the wind to shift, we are finished."

sentences.zh: 彼謂我不能逆風以戰，宜出其不意以擊之，此兵家之奇也。

translations.literal: They think we cannot fight against the wind; we should strike them unawares—this is a strategist's surprise.
translations.idiomatic: They assume we cannot fight into the wind; we should take them by surprise—that is the classic stratagem.

sentences.zh: 」元福乃率麾下開拒馬出戰，諸將繼至，契丹大敗。）〉
