translations.literal: " Yuanfu then led his men to open the abatis and go out to battle; the other generals followed, and the Khitan suffered a great defeat.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfu led his men through the abatis; the other generals followed, and the Khitan was routed.)〉

sentences.zh: 時步騎齊進，追襲二十餘里。

translations.literal: At the time infantry and cavalry advanced together in pursuit for more than twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: Infantry and cavalry pressed the pursuit for more than twenty li.

sentences.zh: 至陽城東，賊軍稍稍成列，我騎復擊之，乃渡河而去。

translations.literal: East of Yangcheng the enemy forces gradually formed ranks; our cavalry struck them again, and they crossed the river and departed.
translations.idiomatic: East of Yangcheng the enemy began to form ranks; our cavalry struck again and drove them across the river.

sentences.zh: 守貞曰：「今日危急極矣，幸諸君奮命，吾事獲濟。

translations.literal: Shouzhen said: "Today was utterly desperate; thanks to you all fighting with your lives, our affair has been saved."
translations.idiomatic: Shouzhen said, "Today was as desperate as it gets; thanks to your fighting with everything you had, we have been saved."

sentences.zh: 兩日以來，人馬渴乏，今吃水之後，腳重難行，速宜收軍定州，保全而還，上策也。

translations.literal: For two days men and horses have been parched and exhausted; now that they have drunk water their legs are heavy and hard to move. We should quickly withdraw the army to Dingzhou and return intact—that is the best plan.
translations.idiomatic: For two days men and horses have gone without water; now that they have drunk, their legs are heavy. We should pull back to Dingzhou while we can—that is the best course.

sentences.zh: 」由是諸將整眾而還。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the generals reformed the troops and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The generals then reformed the army and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是時，契丹主坐車中，及敗走，車行十餘里，追兵既急，獲一橐駝，乘之而走。

translations.literal: At the time the Khitan ruler was seated in his carriage; when he fled in defeat the carriage went more than ten li, but as pursuers pressed close he obtained a camel and rode it away.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler had been in his carriage; when he fled, the carriage went ten li before pursuers closed in, and he escaped on a captured camel.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，杜威等大軍自定州班師入恒州。

translations.literal: On yichou, Du Wei and the main army returned from Dingzhou in formal withdrawal and entered Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Du Wei and the main army marched back from Dingzhou and entered Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子，以車駕將還京，差官往西京告天地宗廟社稷。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on bingzi, because the imperial carriage was about to return to the capital, officials were dispatched to the Western Capital to report to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the fourth summer month, with the emperor about to return to the capital, envoys were sent to the Western Capital to announce the news at the altars of Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temples, and the state.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，駕發澶州。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the imperial carriage departed from Chunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the imperial procession left Chunzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，至京師，曲赦在京禁囚。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the court reached the capital and granted a partial amnesty to prisoners held in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the court reached the capital and granted a partial amnesty to prisoners in the capital.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔鄴都依舊為天雄軍。

translations.literal: On jihai, an edict restored Yedu as the Tianxiong Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai an edict restored Yedu to its status as the Tianxiong Army.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，河東節度使劉知遠封北平王；

translations.literal: On gengyin, Liu Zhiyuan, military commissioner of Hedong, was enfeoffed as Prince of Beiping;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Hedong commissioner Liu Zhiyuan was enfeoffed as Prince of Beiping;

sentences.zh: 恒州節度使杜威加守太傅；

translations.literal: Du Wei, military commissioner of Hengzhou, was given the added title of Acting Grand Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: Hengzhou commissioner Du Wei received acting Grand Tutor;

sentences.zh: 徐州趙在禮移鎮兗州；

translations.literal: Zhao Zaili of Xuzhou was transferred to govern Yanzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zaili moved from Xuzhou to Yanzhou;

sentences.zh: 宋州節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步都指揮使高行周移鎮鄆州，侍衛如故；

translations.literal: Gao Xingzhou, military commissioner of Songzhou and Director-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot, was transferred to govern Yanzhou, retaining his guard command;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xingzhou of Songzhou, director of the Palace Guard, was transferred to Yanzhou while keeping his guard post;

sentences.zh: 鄴都留守馬全節改天雄軍節度使；

translations.literal: Ma Quanjie, military governor of Yedu, was made military commissioner of the Tianxiong Army;
translations.idiomatic: Yedu governor Ma Quanjie became Tianxiong Army commissioner;

sentences.zh: 兗州節度使兼侍衛都虞候李守貞移鎮宋州，加檢校太師兼侍衛親軍副指揮使；

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen, military commissioner of Yanzhou and chief inspector of the Palace Guards, was transferred to govern Songzhou, with the added titles of Acting Grand Preceptor and Deputy Director-in-Chief of the Palace Guard;
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou commissioner and guard chief inspector Li Shouzhen moved to Songzhou with acting Grand Preceptor and deputy guard command;

sentences.zh: 河中節度使安審琦加兼侍中，移鎮許州；

translations.literal: An Shenqi, military commissioner of Hezhong, was given the additional title of Concurrent Palace Attendant and transferred to govern Xuzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Hezhong commissioner An Shenqi received Palace Attendant and was transferred to Xuzhou;

sentences.zh: 許州節度使符彥卿加同平章事，移鎮徐州；

translations.literal: Fu Yanqing, military commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was given the added title of Grand Councilor and transferred to govern Xuzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Xu Prefecture commissioner Fu Yanqing was made grand councilor and transferred to Xuzhou;

sentences.zh: 滑州節度使皇甫遇加同平章事。

translations.literal: Huangfu Yu, military commissioner of Huazhou, was given the added title of Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou commissioner Huangfu Yu was made grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，西京留守景延廣加邑封，改功臣；

translations.literal: On renchen, Jing Yanguang, military governor of the Western Capital, was granted an enlarged fief and a new merit title;
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Western Capital governor Jing Yanguang received an enlarged fief and a new merit title;

sentences.zh: 泰州節度使侯益移鎮河中；

translations.literal: Hou Yi, military commissioner of Taizhou, was transferred to govern Hezhong;
translations.idiomatic: Taizhou commissioner Hou Yi was transferred to Hezhong;

sentences.zh: 定州節度使王周加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Wang Zhou, military commissioner of Dingzhou, was given the added title of Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou commissioner Wang Zhou received acting Grand Preceptor.
